description: This PHP source file defines the class OAuthAuthorizationService, which manages OAuth2 provider interactions in the SuiteCRM environment. It handles provider retrieval, authorization redirects, token acquisition and refresh, token expiration checks, and related logging.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationService
classes.description: Service class for handling OAuth2 provider interactions including provider management, authorization redirects, token retrieval and refresh, token expiration checks, and related utility functions.

methods.name: hasProvider
methods.description: Checks whether a provider with the given ID exists and is properly configured.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth provider connector instance based on the provider ID.

methods.name: authorizationRedirect
methods.description: Initiates OAuth2 authorization by redirecting the user to the provider's authorization URL.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Exchange authorization code for an access token with the OAuth provider.

methods.name: refreshConnectionToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth access token for a given connection object.

methods.name: hasConnectionTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks if the OAuth token has expired based on its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: refreshExpiredOAuthToken
methods.description: Checks for token expiry and refreshes it if expired, handling potential errors.

methods.name: getOAuthRefreshTokenErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates user-facing error messages related to OAuth token refresh failures.

methods.name: mapToken
methods.description: Maps an OAuth access token object to an array suitable for storage or further processing.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the provider configuration array from the database or configuration bean.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at various severity levels.

methods.name: logResponse
methods.description: Logs details of exceptions thrown during token retrieval.

methods.name: cleanSession
methods.description: Clears session variables related to OAuth.

methods.name: getExternalOauthProvidersConnectors
methods.description: Returns the array defining external OAuth provider connector class mappings, potentially extended via external files.
